uhabits.description:
Loop Habit Tracker is a free, open-source Android app designed to help you build positive habits, stay consistent, and achieve long-term goals. Its clean, lightweight interface makes tracking daily routines simple without advertisements, subscriptions, or artificial limits.

Create habits with flexible schedules, including daily goals, several times per week, or custom intervals. Track both yes-or-no activities and measurable goals, set individual reminders, and record progress directly from notifications or customizable home-screen widgets.

Detailed charts, habit scores, streaks, calendars, and statistics help you understand your consistency over time. Add notes to individual days, personalize habit colors, and choose from light, dark, or pure-black themes.

Loop works completely offline and requires no account or internet connection. Your habit data stays on your device rather than being uploaded to a cloud service. Export your information as CSV spreadsheets or SQLite database files for backup or analysis.

Developed by an open-source community under the GNU GPL, Loop offers unrestricted habit tracking without in-app purchases.
